antiPatterns: Uniform card grid (each major concept should use a different visual pattern)
Diamond shapes as arrow targets (Excalidraw arrow binding to diamonds is brittle — use rectangles for arrow-bound nodes)
Manual arrow coordinates (use startBinding/endBinding with element ids)
More than 4 distinct semantic roles in one diagram (causes visual noise)

diagramTypes.architecture: Hub-and-spoke or layered; use service / data / cache / client roles; arrows show traffic flow
diagramTypes.flowchart: Top-down sequential; use start / decision / end roles; diamond decisions branch with labeled arrows
diagramTypes.sequence: Lifelines as vertical lines; arrows horizontal; not a great Excalidraw fit — prefer Mermaid for these
diagramTypes.er: Cylinders for entities (data role); lines (not arrows) for relationships with cardinality labels
